capabilities: Set or clear a target pane via commands
Route clicked note links, wikilinks, and embedded-note link icons to the target pane
Open modifier-clicked links as new tabs in the target pane
Show targeting status in the status bar
Remember the target pane across restarts
disambiguation: It does not change how links render or create links; it only redirects where clicked note links open.
extras: A beta install channel via BRAT is offered. The README documents known behavior around pinned tabs and explicitly leaves Cmd/Ctrl-Alt-click splits and new-window opens to Obsidian's defaults.
motivation: The README frames the plugin around enabling a 'read on the left, open references on the right' workflow, which is the pain it addresses; no separate author statement is given.
problem: Obsidian opens links in the pane you clicked from, so a 'read on the left, open references on the right' workflow requires manually moving or retargeting every link.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin, then add mjsharkey/obsidian_target_pane as a beta plugin.

summary: Pane-routing tool that designates one pane as the destination where all clicked note links open, instead of the pane you clicked in.
